name: DCP — Configuration gaps
description: What the platform cannot do because configuration is absent, as counts: assignment configuration rows, escalation configuration rows, active activity types with no outcome (KI-131), strategy actions with no activity type (KI-106), open cases with no customer, open cases with no MIS bucket, and technical log entries flagged as exceptions. Each dataset is one count; zero rows of configuration is the finding, not an error. Grain: CONFIGURATION. Not narrowed. DCP catalogue DCP-RPT-014.

datasets.name: activityTypesWithoutOutcome
datasets.fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_collectionactivitytype"><attribute name="qdb_collectionactivitytypeid" aggregate="count" alias="rows"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/><condition entityname="outcome" attribute="qdb_activityoutcomeid" operator="null"/></filter><link-entity name="qdb_activityoutcome" from="qdb_activitytypeid" to="qdb_collectionactivitytypeid" link-type="outer" alias="outcome"/></entity></fetch>

columns.name: Active activity types with no outcome

datasets.name: strategyActionsWithoutType
datasets.fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_strategyaction"><attribute name="qdb_strategyactionid" aggregate="count" alias="rows"/><filter><condition attribute="qdb_activitytypeid" operator="null"/></filter></entity></fetch>

columns.name: Strategy actions with no activity type

datasets.name: openCasesWithoutCustomer
datasets.fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_collectioncase"><attribute name="qdb_collectioncaseid" aggregate="count" alias="rows"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/><condition attribute="qdb_customerid" operator="null"/></filter></entity></fetch>

datasets.name: openCasesWithoutBucket
datasets.fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_collectioncase"><attribute name="qdb_collectioncaseid" aggregate="count" alias="rows"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/><condition attribute="qdb_currentarrearbucket" operator="null"/></filter></entity></fetch>

columns.name: Open cases with no MIS bucket

datasets.name: integrationExceptions
datasets.fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_crmlogs"><attribute name="activityid" aggregate="count" alias="rows"/><filter><condition attribute="qdb_isexception" operator="eq" value="1"/></filter></entity></fetch>

columns.name: Integration log entries flagged as exceptions
